groups.saying_opens: حدثت حماد بن سلمة، عن صالح المري

notes: Two acts, each with its own transmitters: Affan told Hammad (saying 1) and told Hammam (saying 2); «كذب» is said by the one told, who is the last link in each
«عن صالح المري» is the subject of the narrated hadith, not a link of this isnad
«قال سمعت عفان» : Affan is a link by «سمعت X»
